example: examples/hsx.json: HSX, the Helically Symmetric eXperiment, its 48 modular coils

flux_Wb.what: toroidal flux enclosed by the surface (Answer.flux)

iota.what: rotational transform of the surface, VMEC's sign (Answer.iota): the slope of the line in the square

N.what: toroidal modes of the series, per field period (Answer.surface.N)

bn_solver.what: largest |B.n|/|B| on the grid shifted half a cell, the solver's own check (Answer.evidence['solver']['bn_off'])

bn_independent.what: largest |B.n|/|B| the independent evaluator finds, climbing from the worst of 4,096 random points to the local maximum (Answer.evidence['independent']['bn_sup'])

series_kept.what: coefficients of R and Z with |rc| or |zs| >= 1e-12 m, which the drawing uses

series_dropped_sum_m.what: sum of |rc| + |zs| over the coefficients the drawing leaves out: a bound on how far any drawn point moves

line_vs_reference_trace_m.what: largest distance, at equal phi over the length drawn on the solid (phi from 0 to phi_end), between the drawn line (the series at theta0 + iota phi, by Answer.points) and the field line from the same start traced by torux.reference.trace.poincare (order-12 Gauss-Legendre in the independent evaluator's field, which shares no code with the solver)
line_vs_reference_trace_m.tracer_step_doubling_what: the tracer's own estimate: the largest difference between its runs at steps h and h / 2

line_vs_own_field_m.what: the same distance to the line integrated in the solver's own field, Answer.field, by scipy's DOP853 (rtol 1e-13, atol 1e-15 m): the integrator's tolerance, not the surface, sets it

drawing_series_vs_torux_m.what: largest distance along the line between the drawing's evaluation of the kept coefficients and torux's own of the whole series (Answer.points)

theta0_rad.what: where the line starts, at phi = 0: the node of the net at the top of the section, lettered theta_0 in the square

phi_end_rad.what: the far cut: the solid is drawn for phi from 0 to here and the sector from here to 2 pi is cut away

line_end_theta_rad.what: theta where the line meets the far cut, in both halves

line_turns.what: how far the drawn line goes round the machine and round the section

net.what: curves of constant theta and of constant phi, every 2 pi / 12: the net on the solid and the grid of the square

slope_triangle_rad.what: lettered 1 and iota in the square

drawing.lettered: 0 and 2 pi at the ends of both angles, theta_0 = pi / 2, the run 1 of the slope triangle and its rise iota

camera.what: a pinhole camera at that azimuth and elevation from the target, which it looks at
